children: reported record third-quarter fiscal 2026 net sales of $23.96 million and consolidated net income of $1.44 million ($0.12 diluted) for the quarter ended July 31, 2026. Gross profit was $8.54 million with a 35.6% margin and operating income rose to $1.76 million. The company reported non-GAAP net income of $2.22 million ($0.19 diluted) and Adjusted EBITDA of $2.65 million for the quarter.
Revenue: Net sales of $23.96 million in Q3 FY2026, up 21% year-over-year from $19.79 million.
Gross profit and margin: Gross profit of $8.54 million; gross margin of 35.6% (160 basis point improvement vs. prior year).
Operating income: Operating income of $1.76 million, up from $720,000 in the prior-year quarter.
Net income and EPS: Consolidated net income of $1.44 million, or $0.12 per diluted share (basic $0.13).
Non-GAAP and EBITDA: Non-GAAP net income of $2.22 million, or $0.19 per diluted share; Adjusted EBITDA of $2.65 million.
Backlog and bookings: Backlog was $18.6 million at quarter end on third-quarter bookings of $22.5 million; backlog subsequently reported at $19.8 million as of the release date.
Revenue mix shift: Continued multi-year mix shift toward higher-value solutions, including custom cabling and integrated systems with greater engineering content and larger project scope.

Market diversification: Expanded end-market exposure into aerospace, edge data centers, AI infrastructure, transportation, and public safety while reducing reliance on cyclical wireless carrier capex.
Operational leverage: Management cites operating leverage as revenue scaled above the $20 million quarterly run rate, driving margin expansion and higher profitability.
Product and go-to-market focus: Emphasis on product innovation, strategic diversification, and channel execution to strengthen OEM and distributor relationships and support sustained demand.
